**Daily Devotional**

**March 18**

*2 Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied. (1 Peter 1:2 KJV)*

Note that this verse ties election to foreknowledge. Only God has the ability to foreknow things in advance of their happening. Since election is tied to God’s foreknowledge, it shows that it is not predestination. Some people teach that God predestinates everything in advance, and therefore some are predestined to be saved and some to be damned. That just is not the case at all. God does not control or allow everything that happens in life. Some believe that nothing happens without God’s causing it or approving it (Sovereignty of God teachings). That is just not true, as God has given mankind a free will (Deuteronomy 30:19), and will not violate it. There are many instances in the Bible where the will of God does not come to pass. For instance it is written that God does not will any to go to hell, but that all should come to repentance and be saved (2 Peter 3:9), but that will not happen. Jesus said that more will enter the broad gate to destruction than will enter the narrow gate to eternal life (Matthew 7:13-14).

The Grace and Peace of God are multiplied to us through the knowledge of God and Jesus our Lord (2 Peter 1:2). To have an abundance of Grace and Peace you need to study the Word of God, and get it in your heart (Romans 12:2), and the Love and Peace that only God can give, will fill you to the brim. Thank you Jesus!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
